title: Buy High, Sell Low
tagline: A financial advisor tool with 4 AI family members giving diverse, dynamic, and collaborative advice.
description:
The project features 4 AI-powered financial advisors, each with a distinct persona.
1. Dad the cautious saver, 
2. Mom the news-savvy gossip, 
3. Sis the long-term HODLer, and 
4. Bro the hype-driven crypto fan. 

Each offers unique (and sometimes conflicting) advice on your financial questions, simulating real family dynamics to help you make smarter (hopefully) decisions.
how_its_made:
The webapp is built using NextJS, TailwindCSS, Shdcn, Langchain & various integrations with partner APIs. Nodit APIs were used to retrieve wallet content and real-time market prices.

Things to improve upon include
1. The agents are not able to carry on a conversation at current and can only offer a single piece of advice.
2. The agents are unable to make real trades at the moment (due to time constraints)
